evaluation_protocol: OUTER_LOSO; fixed threshold 0.80 pre-registered from V5; no per-variant outer-label threshold tuning; iterative development on the same three subjects

calibration_audit.risk: Threshold predictions came from the same subjects used to fit each outer-fold model, so they are training-only but optimistically biased.
calibration_audit.nested_validation_limit: Only two training subjects exist inside each outer fold; a two-way inner split would be high variance and is not claimed as reliable nested validation.

training_window_overlap.interpretation: Expected temporal overlap within a subject; outer LOSO prevents cross-subject leakage.

variant.hypothesis: Preserve observed class priors and recover SAFE_DRIVING recall.
Mild loss weighting can improve minority actions without replacement sampling.
Replacement sampling alone is less aggressive than the V5 double-balanced objective.
A SAFE/PHONE/OTHER gate reduces SAFE_DRIVING-to-phone confusion before fine action classification.
